name: GetMailFolderByName
description: Retrieves details of a mail folder by name from a specified mailbox using Microsoft Graph.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: MailboxAddress
fields.label: Mailbox Address
fields.description: The email address of the mailbox to retrieve the folder from.

fields.name: FolderName
fields.label: Folder Name
fields.description: The display name of the folder to retrieve. The search is case-insensitive and will return the first match found.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: The result of the retrieval operation, including details of the mail folder if found, or an error message if the folder does not exist or if there was an issue with the request.
